responsibility: Tests rpath construction utilities by checking linker flag emission, duplicate elimination, and relative runtime library path calculation across Unix and macOS conventions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `back::apple/tests.rs`, which is about Apple target-version encoding, and `back::linker/tests.rs`, which is about forwarding linker arguments through a C compiler driver, this file exercises `back::rpath`'s own runtime-library-path logic: deduplicating rpaths and deriving relative loader paths such as `@loader_path` or `$ORIGIN`.
